div.div: فَيْحٌ and ↓ فُيُوحٌ Abundance of herbage of the [rain, or season, called] رَبِيع, with ample extent of land: (K:) [accord. to the TK, both are inf. ns., of which the verb is فَاحَ, and the agent is الرَّبِيعُ: but this, I think, is rendered doubtful by what here follows:] فيوح occurs in a verse [as some relate it]; but accord. to the relation of IAar, it is فَتُوح, with ت, [and with fet-h to the ف,] and this, which signifies “ rain, ” is said by Az to be the right reading: the pl. [of فَيْحٌ] is فُيُوحٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
